aaron rodgers.note: Back-to-back 21+ fantasy games, but weekly volatility makes him a matchup streamer only.

alvin kamara.note: Starts only because Etienne (hamstring) is on IR until Week 9; poor efficiency and Kendre Miller is mixing in behind him.

antonio williams.note: 73.2% route rate, 8 targets, 12.6 expected points as WAS's WR2 with McLaurin (hamstring) out - but WAS may be down to third-string QB Kaliakmanis with Daniels (elbow) and Mariota (knee) hurt, which caps it.

brenton strange.note: 7-of-8 for 95 yards in Week 4; role is real but JAX has many mouths to feed and PHI is a tougher Week 5 draw - matchup-based TE2.

brian robinson jr..note: 3 TDs in Week 4 with 10+ touches in three straight games; ATL's run-heavy approach (Penix has thrown 45 passes in two starts) gives him a path, but he's not startable yet.

c.j. stroud.note: 58% rostered; would be the top QB add where available, but he's a streamer, not a season answer.

chris bell.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook.

darius cooper.note: 3 catches for 33 yards and 2 TDs on a career-high 41%+ snap share, but TD regression is coming and the role vanishes when DeVonta Smith returns.

devaughn vele.note: RotoBaller's #10 but 63% owned with no verified snap/target data to justify a roster spot.

dohnte meyers.note: 9 targets as CIN's fill-in WR1 with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) out, but the talent check says no - Kenny's explicit example of opportunity without talent. Trap.

jacoby brissett.note: Yahoo's #1 QB add vs a Detroit defense allowing 20+ fantasy points to every QB it has faced - pure streamer.

jakobi meyers.note: 10 catches on 12 targets with a TD over his last two games as JAX's starting perimeter WR; PPR flex floor.

jaylen wright.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook.

jordyn tyson.note: IR stash with a possible Week 7-9 return; talented rookie with multi-week runway once active.

keaton mitchell.note: Led LAC's backfield in touches (15 for 63 yards) in Week 4, but it's a dead-even three-man split (26/25/25 snaps with Hampton and Vidal) in an 0-4 offense.

kendre miller.note: 19 snaps, 10 routes, 8 touches in Week 4; could pass an inefficient Kamara while Etienne is on IR.

keon coleman.note: 6-of-7 for 116 yards and a TD on a 77.8% route rate after DJ Moore re-injured his shoulder - but he's produced only in the two games Moore exited early; the role shrinks if Moore returns.

khalil shakir.note: Steady slot target in Buffalo's high-scoring offense; safer weekly floor than Coleman and independent of Moore's status.

kirk cousins.note: ESPN's #1 free-agent pickup: 1,026 yards, 11 TDs, 4 INTs while leading LV to 3-1, but he's a one-week streamer at NE, not a season answer.

malik washington.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook despite 28-29% target shares the last two weeks.

mike gesicki.note: TD in 3 of 4 games with Chase (concussion) and Higgins (adductor) out and a soft MIA matchup in Week 5; value evaporates on their return.

mike washington jr..note: Yahoo's #5 overall add and top one-injury-away RB stash; pure handcuff until the LV backfield opens.

ollie gordon ii.note: MIA garbage offense - excluded by rulebook regardless of touches.

roman wilson.note: TDs in back-to-back weeks hide a 16% target share (4th on PIT); TD-or-bust profile with an extremely low floor.

romeo doubs.note: $80M Patriot with rising usage (6/9/58/2 TDs in Week 4, 9 targets), but his every-week value is tied to A.J. Brown staying sidelined - rental risk.

t.j. hockenson.note: 13-of-13 for 119 yards in Week 4 (tied career high in catches) with Jefferson sidelined; 22/195 on the season in an every-down role, though Jefferson's return caps the target ceiling.

tank bigsby.note: Core surgery, placed on IR Monday - out at least a month. Was the add; now he's droppable.

tyreek hill.note: KC reunion talks are real with Rice (hamstring) and Thornton (ankle, season-ending surgery) out, but he's 32, was declining pre-injury, and is targeting November - ceiling stash only.

will shipley.note: Barkley (hamstring) is week-to-week and Bigsby just hit IR after core surgery, making Shipley PHI's lone lead back at JAX in London (29 snaps, 15 routes in Week 4) - but the job evaporates when Barkley returns.

xavier worthy.note: KC's top healthy WR with Rice and Thornton out, but he's on BYE in Week 5 and a Tyreek Hill signing would compress targets - stash only.

zach charbonnet.note: Practicing but ruled out for Week 5 by Macdonald; debut no sooner than Week 6-7. Bench stash only - doesn't dent Wilson's Week 5 value.

picks.name: Keon Coleman
picks.why: Consensus 4.83: 6-of-7 for 116 yards and a TD in Week 4 after DJ Moore (shoulder) left for the second time in four games; 77.8% route rate. Volatile - he's produced only in the two games Moore exited - and the role shrinks if Moore returns.

picks.name: Will Shipley
picks.why: Consensus 5.00: Barkley (hamstring) is week-to-week and Bigsby just hit IR after core surgery, leaving Shipley as PHI's lone lead back at JAX in London. Played 29 snaps with 15 routes in Week 4 - rental only, value expires when Barkley returns.

picks.name: T.J. Hockenson
picks.why: Consensus 5.17: caught all 13 targets for 119 yards in Week 4 (tied career high) with Jefferson sidelined; 22 catches for 195 yards on the season in an every-down role. Elite usage at a thin position, though Jefferson's return caps the target ceiling.

picks.name: Kirk Cousins
picks.why: Consensus 5.17: ESPN's top free-agent pickup - 1,026 yards with 11 TDs and 4 INTs while leading the Raiders to 3-1. Pure one-week streamer at New England; not a season answer.

picks.name: Keaton Mitchell
picks.why: Consensus 5.67: led a messy three-man LAC committee in Week 4 (26 snaps vs 25 each for Hampton and Vidal) with 15 touches for 63 yards. Explosive and trending up, but it's a full committee in an 0-4 offense - boom-bust.

picks.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
picks.why: Consensus 5.67: 15 touches for 67 yards and 3 TDs in Week 4's rout of New Orleans; 10+ touches in three straight games with a TD in two straight. ATL feeds its backs - stash for role growth, not startable yet.

picks.name: Khalil Shakir
picks.why: Consensus 5.83: steady slot target in Buffalo's high-scoring offense; FantasyPros consensus #5. Safer weekly floor than Coleman and his role doesn't depend on Moore's shoulder.

picks.name: Romeo Doubs
picks.why: Consensus 5.83: 6-of-9 for 58 yards and 2 TDs in Week 4 (12/203/2 on the season) on his $80M Patriots deal, with targets rising weekly. Caveat: his every-week value is tied to A.J. Brown staying sidelined.

picks.name: Xavier Worthy
picks.why: Consensus 5.83: KC's top healthy WR with Rice (hamstring) and Thornton (ankle, season-ending surgery) out - but KC is on BYE in Week 5 and a Tyreek Hill reunion would compress targets. Stash only.
